parent_objective: probe whether gap-tail branch weights can repair old-key compact lower-tail erosion without PPO

public_gates: closed-loop old-key compact replay and replay-gate adapter
source-diverse protected gates if old-key replay passes
M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates if proof gates pass
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower old-key gap-p10 threshold
do not skip closed-loop old-key replay
hypothesis: Gap-tail weighted old-key repair can produce a candidate beyond the M370 alpha 0.4 base while retaining the old-key compact gap lower-tail distribution that rejected alpha 0.6.
success_criteria: gap-tail weighted repair candidate passes exact M297/M270 and weighted old-key surrogate gates
closed-loop old-key replay has zero accepted regressions and compact gap p10 above the registered threshold at an alpha greater than 0.4 or exposes a bounded candidate
source-diverse and first replay gates are run if old-key replay passes
failure is classified if weighted exact metrics improve but closed-loop old-key gap tail still erodes
failure_criteria: gap-tail weighted repair cannot move beyond alpha 0.4 without old-key compact gap-p10 failure
weighted old-key surrogate is insensitive to M371 gap-tail rows

commands.name: gap_tail_weighted_repair
commands.command: Run exact_post_ppo_repair with the M373 hard-row plus gap-tail weighted old-key corpus and no PPO.

commands.name: old_key_replay_gate
commands.command: Run old_key_neighborhood_targeted_replay and old_key_neighborhood_replay_gate for exact-feasible candidates.

commands.name: source_diverse_and_first_replay
commands.command: Run source-diverse protected and first replay gates only after the old-key compact gate passes.

decision_rule: M374 can admit a full proof or public gate only if the gap-tail weighted candidate passes closed-loop old-key replay, then source-diverse and first replay gates; it cannot promote directly.
next_blocker: pending M374 gap-tail weighted repair probe
